# TKT-001: Add a farewell helper to core

**Labels:** `type:feature` `area:core`
**Blocked by:** none
**Write surfaces:** `packages/core/src/**`

## Objective
Export `farewell(name)` from `@fixture/core`, mirroring `greet(name)`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `farewell("Ada")` returns `"Goodbye, Ada!"`.
- [ ] A unit test covers it.
